summary: Recent campus crime data for Boise State University reveals a notable increase in incidents related to driving under the influence (DUI) and alcohol violations, with multiple arrests made for these offenses over the past week. In contrast, the number of reported hit-and-run incidents remains concerning, with two occurrences noted within a short timeframe. Vandalism cases, particularly one still under investigation at Selway Suites, also highlight ongoing issues. Compared to previous months, this data suggests a potential uptick in alcohol-related incidents, warranting further attention from campus safety initiatives.
